hooks.command:
RAVEL_PROJECT_DIR="$(ravel_start="$PWD"; ravel_dir="$ravel_start"; while :; do if [ -f "$ravel_dir/.claude/settings.json" ]; then printf '%s
' "$ravel_dir"; break; fi; if [ "$ravel_dir" = / ]; then git -C "$ravel_start" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf '%s
' "$ravel_start"; break; fi; ravel_dir="$(dirname "$ravel_dir")"; done)"; ravel_inherited="${RAVEL_PYTHON:-}"; unset RAVEL_PYTHON PYTHONPATH PYTHONHOME PYTHONSTARTUP; if [ -f "$RAVEL_PROJECT_DIR/.ravel/hook-runtime.sh" ]; then . "$RAVEL_PROJECT_DIR/.ravel/hook-runtime.sh"; elif [ -d "$RAVEL_PROJECT_DIR/src/ravel" ] && [ -f "$RAVEL_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/pretooluse-bash.sh" ] && [ "$(git -C "$RAVEL_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" = "$(cd "$RAVEL_PROJECT_DIR" && pwd -P)" ]; then export PYTHONPATH="$RAVEL_PROJECT_DIR/src"; fi; RAVEL_PYTHON="${RAVEL_PYTHON:-${ravel_inherited:-python3}}"; export PYTHONSAFEPATH=1; ravel_input="$(cat)"; printf '%s' "$ravel_input" | "$RAVEL_PYTHON" -m ravel.workflow.host_guards --host gemini --phase pre --project "$RAVEL_PROJECT_DIR"; RAVEL_GUARD_STATUS=$?; [ "$RAVEL_GUARD_STATUS" -eq 0 ] && exit 0; if [ "$RAVEL_GUARD_STATUS" -ne 2 ]; then ravel_ledger="${RAVEL_STATE_DIR:-$HOME/.local/state/ravel}/host-integrity"; mkdir -p "$ravel_ledger" 2>/dev/null; ravel_sid="$(printf '%s' "$ravel_input" | tr -d '
' | sed -n 's/.*"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([A-Za-z0-9._:-]*\)".*/\1/p')"; printf '{"schema_version": 1, "kind": "hook_failure", "hook": "%s", "project": "%s", "session": "%s", "utc": "%s"}
' "gemini-pre" "$(printf '%s' "$RAVEL_PROJECT_DIR" | tr -d '\042\134')" "$ravel_sid" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$ravel_ledger/events.jsonl" 2>/dev/null; echo "BLOCKED: RAVEL host guard is unavailable; this session is labelled NOT GOVERNED" >&2; exit 2; fi; echo "BLOCKED: RAVEL host guard refused" >&2; exit 2
